summary: Portal RBAC controls who sees templates in the catalog and can submit jobs; AAP RBAC is the source of truth: only templates visible to the configured token (ansible.rhaap.token) sync, and AAP checks each user's execute permission at launch, so a visible template can still fail to run.
questions: How do portal RBAC and AAP RBAC relate?
User sees a template in the portal but cannot run it
Which job templates are synced to the portal?

answer_card.title: Portal vs AAP permissions
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Portal RBAC**: who can see templates in the catalog and submit jobs.
- **AAP RBAC** (source of truth):
  - sync scope: only job templates the configured token (`ansible.rhaap.token`) can access are synced
  - visibility and execution of job templates
  - checks the user's **Execute** permission before launching

Seeing a template in the portal without AAP Execute permission means the job won't run.
